notes: The 'of' after 'memory' is given to רַב as the rectum of the outer chain under rule 19, with רַב's own word rendered attributively as 'great'; the competing reading places the 'of' on טוּב as the English head noun of the phrase.
The 'of' after 'sing' is the verb's under rule 44, reaching צִדְקָתְךָ, which the Hebrew writes as a bare object.
